verdict.rationale: Atlas is documented as the Delaware registered agent, and one hands-on community user says they liked Atlas's filing reminders. No first-party documentation describes deadline alerts for annual reports or franchise tax, and the agent role is only evidenced for Delaware. missing for 10: first-party documentation of annual report and franchise tax deadline alerts, evidence of alert timing and channels, coverage for states beyond Delaware, independent corroboration beyond a single comment.

support.subject: As a founder, I get alerts ahead of each state's annual report and franchise tax deadlines for every state where the provider is my agent

citations.quote: Satisfy Delaware compliance requirements with a registered agent.
